system.description:
Small, cheerful country folk with mischievous streaks. They enjoy life’s simple pleasures.

Population: Halflings are uncommon but widely known. They form about 10% of the population.

Origins: Most halfling villages are clustered in the sunny, rolling meadows in the Duchy of Montmar. Some also live on the fringes of the Lowland Moor, where they have a knack for merging seamlessly with the natural landscape.
